tree_generator: formal bfs_oracle.c graph(n,1): up to parent (v-1)/2 and children 2*v+1,2*v+2 in four slots, n sentinel for absent edges

permutation_generator: identity permutation; root 0 fixed; uint64 state=0x8af20c354d159761; for i=n-1 down to 2: state=state*6364136223846793005+1 modulo 2^64; j=1+state%i; swap permutation[i],permutation[j]; remap both vertex IDs and valid neighbors

collision_generator: leaves=1<<depth; tree=2*leaves-1; groups=leaves/2; n=tree+groups; n sentinel; v<leaves-1 has edges 2*v+1,2*v+2; leaf v=leaves-1+i has edges tree+i/2,tree+i/2,tree+groups-1-i/2,v; final group vertices have absent edges only

oracle_contract: independent FIFO distances and n unreachable sentinel; compare all n distances and all 4*n input words in both modes; regenerate large original input after WF temporary workspace is freed

observer_contract: completed nonempty source rows; completed nonempty incoming buckets, including duplicate-only buckets; completed new discoveries; TLS caller/helper identity; actual split spans, weights and returned budgets unchanged
qualification_limit: observed atomics perturb scheduling; no timing claim; original tree has no nonempty routing rows on helpers; large unobserved inputs remain unverified at this record

prospective_c_flags: -std=c11 -pthread -O3 -fno-fast-math -ffp-contract=off -fno-lto; vectorization permitted; no arm64 target override
prospective_wf_flags: ordinary --par; -std=c11 -pthread -O2 -Wno-override-module; unchanged runtime sources and policy; no observer

prospective_protocol: five fixed passes; fresh processes; one verified warm-up plus three verified warm calls; zero gap; rotated/reversed cell order; 40 identical-image primary null processes then 70 comparison processes
prospective_null_rule: each primary fixture/width median paired B/A wall ratio must be within [0.97,1.03]; otherwise inconclusive and stop before comparison; no rerun-to-green

prospective_selection: outbox W4/FIFO W1 median wall <=0.80 on at least one primary; outbox W4/W1 <=0.97 on both; at least 4/5 paired wins for each claimed improvement; qualified slower-than-FIFO result on both ends trial; diagnostics cannot rescue failure
prospective_limits: preflight native construction and untimed correctness 30s; null 60s; comparison 60s; preserve failure/timeout/hash-drift/competing-load outcomes; no elapsed-time source rejection
